# CG-SRV-001: Server removed

A server URL present in the baseline is absent from the candidate.

**Why it matters:** The server list tells consumers where the API lives.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Servers](./#srv) |
| Detects | `server.removed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Server {url} was removed.
>
> Consumers configured with this server may no longer reach the API.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the server entry while it is still deployed, or announce the change.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: one of two hosts removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://us.x/v1'}, {url: 'https://eu.x/v1'}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://us.x/v1'}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Server https://eu.x/v1 was removed.

### Does not fire: servers reordered

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- servers: [{url: 'https://us.x/v1'}, {url: 'https://eu.x/v1'}]
+ servers: [{url: 'https://eu.x/v1'}, {url: 'https://us.x/v1'}]
  paths: {}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Actual deployments are unknown.

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-SRV-001
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
```
